description.value: Myth Grill & Yakitori Bistro is a modern Japanese charcoal-grill restaurant in Richmond, cooking skewers and grilled meats over traditional binchotan charcoal to highlight seasonal ingredients. Part of the Myth Group restaurant family, it aims for a relaxed urban tavern atmosphere blending yakitori tradition with sake and a cozy wooden interior. Cyclists passing through Richmond's Ackroyd Road commercial corridor could use it as a sit-down or takeout meal stop.
